name: John's Horrors
source:
It's 1867. You're a young gay Victorian man, and you haven't seen your brother John in a week.

[From [url=https://coreyjaechicken.itch.io/johns-horrors]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1867年。你是個生活在維多利亞時代的年輕男同性戀，已經整整一個星期沒見到你的兄弟約翰了。
